entries.t: <FACE:14>Whoa, nice manners.<NL>Gonna just ignore us?<WAIT><FACE:04>(Of all times…<NL>had to be these two)
<FACE:14>I hear you finally got<NL>yourself a Medabot
<FACE:04>But I just built it…<NL>I can't Robattle yet…
<FACE:15>My Bugstink's beam is<NL>way stronger!<WAIT><FACE:1A>Beams eat so much AP<NL>you can hardly fire!
<FACE:18>Ugh… y-you stand on a<NL>generator point<WAIT>to top up your AP!
<FACE:1A>Then you can't move!<NL>If nobody's in range,<WAIT>you still can't fire!<NL><WAIT><FACE:1A>And a beam's range has<NL>a hole on the inside<WAIT>so if they close in,<NL>you can't do a thing…
<FACE:03>(…I won…)<NL><WAIT>(My first Robattle…<NL>and I actually won!)
<FACE:18>…Not bad at all!<WAIT><FACE:14>But the terrain suited<NL>your biped Medabot<WAIT>Don't call it skill!
<FACE:1A>Your Medabot's attacks<NL>look strong, but<WAIT>if my Sicklecutter's<NL>alter attack<WAIT>slaps a bad status on,<NL>you're nothing to me!
<FACE:14>But <PLAYER><NL><WAIT>has a part that clears<NL>bad statuses, y'know<WAIT>If he uses it, doesn't<NL>the status come off?
<FACE:1D>Urk! Th-then I'll just<NL>do it over and over!<WAIT>Sooner or later he<NL>can't shake it off!
<FACE:14>But your Medabot's<NL>legs don't fit here,<WAIT>and alter attacks are<NL>melee, short range<WAIT>so if they shoot from<NL>far off, you're done…
<FACE:1C>Waaaaah!<NL><WAIT>At this rate he'll<NL>know our weak spots!
<FACE:1C>No way, I lost too…<NL>What a shock!
<FACE:04>(I've loved Medabots<NL>way before I got him)<WAIT>(I'd read up on them<NL>a lot, so I knew…)
<FACE:00>(I won my very first<NL>Robattle…)<WAIT>(And two in a row!)

<FACE:1E>My brother always<NL>treats me as a child…<WAIT>That space station has<NL>kept him so busy<WAIT>I hardly saw him, and<NL>at last we go out…<WAIT>I was looking forward<NL>to today…<WAIT><FACE:21>But this is no better<NL>than staying home…
<FACE:00>The old schoolhouse…<NL><WAIT>Guys who cause trouble<NL>love spots like this…
<FACE:03>Come to think of it,<NL>the old schoolhouse…<WAIT>has those creepy tales<NL>of the 7 Mysteries…
<FACE:04>Hmmmmmm<NL><WAIT>Ghosts are scary, but<NL>I want my Medal back…
<FACE:04>Hmmmmmmmmm…<NL><WAIT>But those 7 Mysteries…<NL>I did want the truth…
<FACE:00>The 7 Mysteries…<NL><WAIT>Like the music room<NL>piano playing alone…
<FACE:00>There's a ton of<NL>creepy stories…<WAIT>And they still haven't<NL>torn this place down…<NL>
<FACE:00>…the workers are too<NL>spooked to take it…
<FACE:03>Waaaaaaah!<NL><WAIT>I-I heard it clearly<NL>that time! A Mystery?
<FACE:04>The old gym's ahead…<NL><WAIT>«The voice under the<NL>floor», the scariest…
<FACE:01>Argh! It's a mystery<NL>'cause nobody looks!<WAIT>Here goes nothing!
<FACE:00>It's scary, but it's<NL>for my Medal<WAIT>I'm getting it back
<FACE:11>Sorry, but I'd like to<NL>tour the school alone<WAIT>So would you mind if I<NL>excused myself here?
<FACE:5E>Eek! What's the idea!<NL><WAIT>Shiden's shaking MY<NL>hand, not yours!
<FACE:5D>Hey, out of the way!<NL>I can't see Shiden!
<FACE:5D>And I'd finally gotten<NL>close to him too…
<FACE:00>Notices posted all<NL>over the place…<WAIT>School rules were just<NL>as strict back then…
<FACE:00>This shoe locker still<NL>has a name on it…
<FACE:00>How many students used<NL>this, I wonder…<WAIT>It's falling apart…
<FACE:00>«On Moving to the New<NL>Building»…<WAIT>…Time stopped here the<NL>day they moved out…
<FACE:00>«No running in the<NL>halls», huh…<WAIT><FACE:02>Some things never<NL>change…
<FACE:00>The door's blocked up.<NL>I can't get in…
